{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rite of Commencement''' was a powerful [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] ritual used in the creation of [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocrons]]. The Rite of Commencement trapped the creator's cognitive essence, or the "[[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]]" into the [[capstone]] of the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]. With the capstone successfully imbued with the cognitive essence, the creator could proceed in completing the construction of their holocron.
